name: Saren Arterius
reference_scope: First reference is a game render, cropped at torso. Second is the official full-body armor concept, reproduced in the official-art gallery. Lower-body details are concept-supported, not verified against a full-body final in-game model.
prompt: Create exactly ONE full-body isolated character portrait of SAREN ARTERIUS as the equipped turian seen during Mass Effect 1, using these two official visual references. The first image is the in-game look and is authoritative for identity, head shape, real materials, chest and shoulder armor. The second is the official front/back costume design, supplied to clarify the entire equipment layout and anatomy. Preserve the specific gray turian face plates, long narrow cheek/crest spines projecting backward, dark inset eyes with subtle blue illumination, long armored neck and the recognizable silhouette. No painted facial tattoos. Reproduce the actual asymmetrical outfit: pale silver-gray segmented armor and a very dark textured undersuit, narrow pale collar/chest edges, dark corrugated tubes crossing the left side of the torso with small blue illumination, and the much larger dark biomechanical shoulder and arm on his ANATOMICAL LEFT. His ANATOMICAL RIGHT arm is the normal narrower arm covered in pale armor. Do not mirror this arrangement. Preserve the exact shown thigh plates, angular kneecaps, narrow shin guards, raised turian hocks, long digitigrade leg geometry and pointed armored toes. Use the game render's realistic physical proportions and materials rather than making the drawing's outlines into a cartoon. This is the recognizable armored turian with intact organic face, not the skeletal final synthetic boss form and not a generic turian or Garrus. Show him standing calmly, unarmed, torso and head turned three quarters toward SCREEN RIGHT, looking right, both hands empty and relaxed a little away from the torso, both feet entirely visible and individually readable. The complete figure must fit comfortably with wide empty margins: leave about twelve percent clear space above the head spines and below the toes. Soft neutral studio illumination, sharp high-resolution realistic game-character finish, clean silhouette. Keep visible canonical asymmetry and do not add unseen gadgets or invented ornament. One person, one view only, no sheet or multiple poses. No background scenery, floor, cast ground shadow, caption, border, weapon, HUD, smoke or attack effects. TRUE transparent alpha background.
